title: Edit tax rate locks once invoiced, unlocks on reversal, needs permission
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user (that role holds every permission, including Part sales - Create & Edit and Invoicing & payments - Create & Edit).
  • A test customer exists.
  • A test vendor exists to order parts from.
  • The invoiced sale: a new part sale started today for the test customer (a sale started before this release handles cores the old way), with the part "Brake Pads" (Quantity 1, Vendor = the test vendor, Sell Price $290.91).
  • The part is ordered and received, so the sale is Complete.
  • The sale has been invoiced and paid in full, and that payment then reversed: the sale stays Invoiced, with no payment applied.
  • Two tax rates exist (for example a second one, "ZZAUTOTEST 6%" at 6.00%).
  • The user without the permission: a spare test user with the role "ZZAUTOTEST No part sale edit" (built from a template, for example "Parts Manager"): Part sales - Create & Edit unticked, Part sales View left ticked.
custom_steps:
1. On the invoiced sale, open the Financial Info card and look for Edit tax rate.
  2. Reverse the invoice (Finance tab -> the menu ( ... ) -> Reverse -> Reverse in the Warning dialog) and read the sale's status.
  3. On the Financial Info card, click the edit icon (tooltip "Edit tax rate"), pick the second tax rate (e.g. 6.00%) in the Taxes list and click Save.
  4. Click Create Invoice again; on the new invoice read the tax rate, then look for Edit tax rate on the card.
  5. Sign in as the user without the permission, open a part sale, and look for the Edit tax rate control.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • On the invoiced sale the Financial Info card is read-only and Edit tax rate is not shown.
  • After reversing the invoice the sale is back to Complete and Edit tax rate is offered again; the new rate (e.g. 6.00%) saves.
  • The new invoice carries the rate that was set before it was created (e.g. 6.00%), and the card is read-only again.
  • A user without Part sales -> Create & Edit does not see Edit tax rate at all.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10264 (Change the tax on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 3; design canvas boards S3_*; read 5 Oct 2026 (specification edited that day). Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-N1: “Once the part sale is invoiced or paid, the card is read-only and the action is not offered”
  • S3-N1: “Reversing the invoice unlocks it again, as on a work order: the reversal puts the sale back to Complete, and the card can be edited whenever the sale is not invoiced or paid”
  • S3-N1: “The next invoice locks the rate it carries then”
  • S3-N2: “A user without the permission above does not see the action”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
